runner: Qwen 3.8 Max Preview via pi agent
notes: Single self-contained HTML, vanilla canvas 2D, no libraries. Static sunset sky with sun disc + radial glow and faint stars; procedural ridged-noise mountain/hill bands; a dark distant tree-line, mid roadside trees and telephone poles, asphalt with fast lane dashes, and a blurred foreground grass rush — each layer on its own parallax factor over one periodic world-scroll value so the scene loops seamlessly. Hand-authored red saloon profile with wheel-arch cut-outs, glass with a sunset reflection, body crease and head/tail lamps; wheels roll without slip (angle = scroll / radius) with five-spoke rims; subtle body bob + pitch tie the car to the road. Verified headless in Edge: 0 console/runtime errors.
